shell.title: Build a company, not a collection of agents.
shell.description: From your first CEO to your first formal delivery, Eidolon connects real employees, runtimes, knowledge, code and review gates into an AI company you can operate.

login.title: Welcome Back
login.passkeyUnavailable: Passkeys are unavailable here. Use HTTPS in production.

register.title: Create Your Eidolon Company
register.description: After email verification you receive a completely empty AI company that you own. No AI employees are created for you.
register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters; password managers and paste are supported

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.ready: Local verification is ready for {{email}}. Your empty company is created only after confirmation.
verify.sent: A verification link was sent to {{email}}. Finish verification to continue.

errors.unknown: The operation did not complete. Please try again.

tutorial.skipConfirm: Skipping only closes the guide; it will not create or delete business data. Skip it?

center.title: Tutorial Center
center.description: Replay focused chapters whenever you add a new company capability.

company_setup.label: Meet your new company
company_setup.explanation: This is a completely empty AI company. Human accounts make decisions; AI Employees are explicitly hired and persist as staff.

hire_ceo.label: Hire your first CEO
hire_ceo.explanation: Use the real Employee Onboarding Wizard to hire leadership. The tutorial never creates fake employees.

configure_ceo.label: Configure the CEO runtime and provider
configure_ceo.explanation: Employee is identity, Runtime is the execution environment, Provider supplies model service, and Model is the selected model. Mock resources are always labeled.

cloud_docs.label: Create the first company document
cloud_docs.explanation: Use Markdown for agent collaboration; use DOCX or PDF export for formal customer material.

git_setup.label: Connect Git
git_setup.explanation: Install built-in Gitea or connect GitLab, Gitea, GitHub Enterprise, or another compatible service.

hire_engineer.label: Hire your first engineer
hire_engineer.explanation: Run real provisioning again to assign a runtime, workspace, Git, documents, and permissions to the engineer.

hire_qa.label: Check QA coverage
hire_qa.explanation: Independent QA supports separation of duties. You can defer it and the project will retain a coverage reminder.

create_project.label: Create the Classic Snake project
create_project.explanation: Start from the sample Structured Project Intake and confirm requirements, constraints, deliverables, and review plan.

requirements_review.label: Complete requirements review
requirements_review.explanation: AI has prepared the analysis; a human must approve the requirements baseline before system design can start.

design_review.label: Complete design review
design_review.explanation: Inspect system design, review slides, speaker notes, and traceability, then make the human decision.

development.label: Inspect development output
development.explanation: Review staff, tasks, repositories, branches, commits, artifacts, and activity to verify real team work.

testing.label: Complete internal and acceptance testing
testing.explanation: Internal testing covers defects and regression; acceptance testing verifies customer-visible criteria.

acceptance_review.label: Run acceptance review
acceptance_review.explanation: The final Human Gate: a person confirms acceptance evidence and the delivery preview.

delivery.label: Generate the final delivery package
delivery.explanation: The package brings together source, builds, DOCX, PPTX, manuals, release notes, minutes, and checklists.

security.title: Security Center
security.description: Signed in as {{email}}. Passkeys use WebAuthn; Eidolon stores only the public credential.
security.passkeyHelp: Use iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager, Windows Hello, or a security key.
security.removeConfirm: Remove this passkey from the account?
security.sessionHelp: Review browser sessions and revoke any device you do not recognize.
security.logoutAllConfirm: End every session, including this device?

founding.title: {{company}} has been established and is waiting for its first employee
founding.description: This newly founded AI company has no employees yet. Build it into a working software team through real onboarding, resource configuration, and project delivery.
founding.note: The guide calls real APIs, resumes after refresh, and never creates fake data when skipped.
